title: git-cleanup configuration
description: Schema for ~/.config/git-cleanup/config.json, .gitcleanup.json, or a --config file. All keys optional — unspecified keys fall through to the next config layer or the built-in defaults. Unknown keys are ignored by the loader but flagged here to catch typos.

$schema.description: Editor hint only (e.g. https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Asunachi/git-cleanup/main/support/config.schema.json). Ignored by git-cleanup.

deleteMergedAfterDays.description: Age in days after which merged branches are pruned.

warnUnmergedAfterDays.description: Age in days after which unmerged branches are reported as stale.

track.description: Enrich branches with pull-request state from the forge.

staleAfterDays.description: PRs with no activity for this many days are listed as stale.

closeStaleAfterDays.description: Stale PRs older than this may be closed by `prs --close`.

closeComment.description: Comment posted when `prs --close` closes a PR.

pruneMerged.description: Delete merged branches on the remote too (with `--remote`).

deleteAbandonedAfterDays.description: Remote branches with a closed PR this old are candidates for deletion.

enabled.description: Write a git bundle before force/remote deletions (default true).

retainDays.description: Sweep backup bundles older than this many days on every run (0 = keep forever).

hosts.description: Claim self-hosted forge hostnames, e.g. { "git.example.com": "gitlab" }. An explicit mapping always wins over hostname heuristics.

mode.description: Default sweep policy: "report" never deletes (default), "prune" goes through the same confirmation gate as `prune`.

remote.description: Prune remote branches in sweep mode "prune".

reportFile.description: Write the combined sweep markdown report to this file.

reportIssue.description: Post the report as a forge issue: true (default title) or { "title": "..." }.

protected.description: Glob patterns of branches that are never touched (defaults: main, master, develop, release/**, staging, qa, checked-out and base branches).

match.description: Branch glob pattern this rule applies to.

mode.description: "merged" only prunes merged branches; "any" prunes unmerged work too (dangerous — requires explicit rules).

minAgeDays.description: Minimum branch age in days before the rule applies.

repos.description: Repositories to sweep. Paths resolve relative to the config file that defines them.
